traps_and_disagreements.detail: The assigned sweep command omits --hidden, so it returns only 1 of the 12 matching files (it misses everything under .ufo/). Reported as a defect of the assignment, not of the targets. Both forms are recorded above; the --hidden form is authoritative.

`git -C lore-shokunin log --oneline r87-B1 --not --all | wc -l` prints 3, but that is NOT 3 commits: the worktree basename is not a ref, so git writes 'fatal: ambiguous argument r87-B1: unknown revision or path not in the working tree.' plus a 'Use --' hint and echoes 'r87-B1' - three lines on stderr that the pipe swallows. Re-run with 2>/dev/null, or use the HEAD sha: `git log --oneline 28706dc... --not --all | wc -l` -> 0. Any seat that counted via the basename produced a spurious unique=3. Verified identical failure mode for r87-C6-M1 (also not a ref).

Caveat for the parent, not a change of verdict: lore-shokunin (the owning lane) itself is not clean - `git status --porcelain` -> '?? .scratch/' (dirty=1) and `git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline` -> 3 unpushed commits on main (6cec83a gitignore: stop re-tracking per-seat wave scratch; 1659a42 cleanup: drop closed-round seat scratch trees; f553a27 chore: drop seat scratch/archive caches). AGENTS.md's blanket rule 'never touch an artifact whose owning lane has dirty or unpushed work' could be read as NOT-SAFE here. I did NOT apply it: the four targets are detached scratch registrations (no branch of their own), their HEAD 28706dc is reachable from refs/remotes/origin/main, and prune touches only .git/worktrees/<name> metadata, none of which overlaps lore's unpushed main commits or its untracked .scratch/. Round 1 already classified the same 19 lore registrations SAFE(metadata-prune) with this same lane state. Flagging so the parent can adjudicate explicitly rather than silently.
